fixture.layout: 20 columns by 25 rows of independently rotated dynamic boxes plus anchored distance joints across the top row

fixedWork.broadphase: stable insertion-sorted sweep-and-prune over rotated-box AABBs; ties by body id
fixedWork.narrowphase: four-axis oriented-box SAT; minimum-overlap axis creates one deterministic support-midpoint manifold
fixedWork.contactOrder: sweep order with lower body id first; ground manifold precedes body pairs
fixedWork.jointOrder: ascending joint id after contacts in every solver iteration
fixedWork.velocityUpdate: semi-implicit Euler with force and torque integration, linear/angular damping, contact normal and Coulomb tangent impulses, angular lever arms, and anchored distance-joint impulses
fixedWork.positionUpdate: bounded split-impulse linear contact and anchored distance-joint correction; all angular response is applied by the full lever-arm velocity constraints
fixedWork.trigonometry: shared strict-f32 seventh-order sine and sixth-order cosine polynomials after deterministic [-pi,pi] wrapping
fixedWork.stateQuantization: after every solver iteration and timestep, round x,y,angle,vx,vy,angularVelocity to nearest 1e-3 using half-away-from-zero

oracle.completeState: all x,y,angle,vx,vy,angularVelocity values for every body at 300-step checkpoints and final state
oracle.quantization: checkpoint comparison validates every stored strict-f32 scalar after the frozen solver quantization

limitations: Scalar, single-threaded discrete solver with one contact point per oriented-box pair; no sleeping, continuous collision detection, or warm starting.
This candidate does not alter the byte-frozen v1 catalog and is not accepted coverage until independent review and retained browser evidence pass.
